one thing i didn't mention on the call but i do think it would be wise to do our product drop(s) thematically as a whole... shopify (and etsy) push "collections" so while we are not trying to generate huge sales it does make us look more legitimate and like we know what we are doing if we brand/conceptualize "capsules" rather than just one-off random items (though having a specialty item like the giant vape that doesnt fit the entire theme, is good too but even that can be branded to match the rest of the collection.
